parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same defect: the eviction loop in _store compares len(self._keys_by_country), the number of countries, against max_entries instead of the total number of cached entries, so the cache never bounds its size. Description A adds detail about per-country growth and the old lru_cache, while Description B frames it as unbounded per-postal-code growth, but the root cause and location match.
